description: Shared thread list of the PDF annotation panels (TmPdfViewer and TmPdfAnnotator): renders each thread as an expandable TmPdfThreadCard whose detail hosts the quoted text, the comments (TmPdfCommentItem) and the sticky reply composer (TmPdfComposer). The owning panel keeps only its header and its new-thread/draft prompt. The kind caption of plain comment threads is controlled by HideCommentKind.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: Annotation threads to render (the resolved filter applies on top).

parameters.name: SelectedThreadIdChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the selected thread id changes.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id, used for comment permission checks.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether interaction (reply composer, comment menu) is disabled.

parameters.name: TestIdBase
parameters.description: Base of the panel's testid contract (e.g. pdf-annotation or pdf-annotator); the card and composer test ids derive as {base}-thread, {base}-detail, {base}-reply-*, {base}-resolve, {base}-reopen and {base}-empty.

parameters.name: ColorResolver
parameters.description: Resolves the display color of a thread. When null the helper default is used.

parameters.name: HideCommentKind
parameters.description: Hides the kind caption of plain comment threads so only Highlight/Stamp/Drawing carry a label. The viewer's panel passes true; the annotator keeps captions for every kind.

parameters.name: EmptyText
parameters.description: Localized empty-state text rendered when no visible thread remains.

parameters.name: ReplyPlaceholder
parameters.description: Placeholder of the sticky reply composer.

parameters.name: ReplySubmitLabel
parameters.description: Submit label of the sticky reply composer.

parameters.name: ResolveLabel
parameters.description: Label of the resolve action on an open thread.

parameters.name: ReopenLabel
parameters.description: Label of the reopen action on a resolved thread.

parameters.name: OnReplyRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reply is requested.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when an existing comment body is edited.

parameters.name: OnResolveRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when resolving a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnReopenRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when reopening a thread is requested.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting a comment is requested.
